notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The Forest Lookouts page has only a label, the county, the agency and the word Removed. Build date, height, staffing, removal date and current site are unknown, and two web searches found nothing about this tower. The Encyclopedia of Arkansas and Preserve Arkansas pages are statewide or town background and do not describe this tower; they are used only for context. The Preserve Arkansas count is undated. The record height is null and no height is proposed. Worth checking with the Arkansas Forestry Commission's Drew County office in Monticello.
